title: DASH disconnected / Lost carb count
body:
Maybe a bug, not sure. I'm changing G6 sensor. As BGs are lowish, I disconnect pump for 1h.

Some time later, I start lunch and enter carbs (45g).

At the end of the meal, I reconnect DASH to inject. The carb count stay unknown... Even after waiting, it never came back.

![Screenshot_20220628-104025_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/176427114-525d36ec-8998-49f7-a818-1ca50c3afc3f.jpg)

![Screenshot_20220629-132808_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/176427172-3aa96dfc-853f-4405-92e5-a6cf1e4c704b.jpg)

![Screenshot_20220629-132922_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/176427217-0740de57-e91e-442e-a9d8-87ace1ab5fe1.jpg)

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1656502169706.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/9010059/AndroidAPS_LOG_1656502169706.log.zip)

comments.body:
Thinking more about this issue. 

Most probably, the COB _Not Available_ is related to the fact that there are no BGs and thus no way for AAPS to know the COB. It could deduce by using min_5m_carbimpact...

Feel free to close if it is not a bug but a feature ;)
